microphone_permission: Respect OS permission and browser gesture rules; within the allowed session arm automatically after actual model end. Show truthful denied/unavailable state and guardian advance.
early_child_voice_during_question: Does not advance. Preserve dialogue and show listen state clearly.
parent_tap_during_model: Cancel current model and invalidate its completion callback before one REACT.
simultaneous_tap_vad: Atomic once guard per event_id and run_generation_id; discard stale callbacks after seek, replay or reset.
narrator_or_character_output_detection: Detection disabled during question/model output; use verified echo/tail handling, not an invented fixed delay.
vad_acceptance: Calibrated speech activity start/end and noise rejection; no arbitrary loud sound as completed speech.
no_response: Never punish, auto-succeed, or demand an exact phrase. Keep replay and guardian controls.
profile_source: Use the verified existing engine profile and verified Star Album comparison only if available; do not claim it has been implemented here.
learner_causality: 윤수는 준비·동행을 돕는다. 음악 앞 학교 선택은 피노키오가 스스로 하며 영어 정확도·음량은 서사의 자격이 아니다.
